TestStandardMethods.desc: Check requests that use standard HTTP methods

TestArbitraryMethods.desc: Check requests that use arbitrary alphanumeric methods

TestMethodCaseSensitivity.desc: Check that request methods are not case-sensitive

TestOverlappingMethods.desc: Check routes that use the same path but different request methods

TestHardcodedPaths.desc: Check that common routes were not hard-coded in an empty router

TestLongerPaths.desc: Check requests to arbitrary paths with multiple directories

TestShorterPaths.desc: Check requests to very short paths

TestPathSlashes.desc: Check that leading and trailing slashes in paths are ignored

TestPathOverwriting.desc: Check that adding a route more than once updates its handler

TestIntermediatePaths.desc: Check unroutable paths that are prefixes of routable ones (and vice versa)

TestLongestPath.desc: Check that router finds the longest possible matching path

TestRepeatedPathNames.desc: Check that routes can have subdirectories with same name as parent

TestCaptureResolves.desc: Check that routes with captures can be resolved at all, ignoring whether RawQuery is correct

TestBasicCapture.desc: Check that capture yields correct RawQuery

TestArbitraryPathCapture.desc: Check that capture works at an arbitrary position in an arbitrary path

TestMultipleCaptures.desc: Check that several captures can appear in one route

TestCaptureMultipleValues.desc: Check that multiple values can be captured under a single key

TestCaptureKeyOverwriting.desc: Check that keys are overwritten when adding several capturing routes

TestAmbiguousPaths1.desc: Check that non-capturing routes have precedence over capturing ones

TestAmbiguousPaths2.desc: Check non-capturing route precedence with ambiguous routes

TestAmbiguousPaths3.desc: Check non-capturing route precedence with very ambiguous routes

TestAmbiguousPaths4.desc: Check non-capturing route precedence with longer ambiguous routes

TestGreedyResolver.desc: Check that greedy resolution doesn't cause router to ignore valid routes

TestGreedyAmbiguousPaths1.desc: Check precedence and greedy resolution with ambiguous routes

TestGreedyAmbiguousPaths2.desc: Check precedence and greedy resolution with very ambiguous routes

TestNonlocalCaptureOverwriting.desc: Check that capture keys are only overwritten when absolutely necessary
